freeze_prerequisites: Final 742 GLB, runtime, CSS, machine modules, configuration, and mechanism bytes are committed.
A pending candidate receipt has been regenerated from that exact tree with frozen-source verification.
The current 600S and ES1930M release receipts and runtime bytes are unchanged during capture.
The local static server is addressed by one recorded origin and every route uses diagnostics=1 where supported.

common_capture.gpu_metadata: Record WebGL API plus unmasked vendor/renderer when WEBGL_debug_renderer_info is observable; otherwise record unavailable and the exact reason.
common_capture.accessibility_tree_slider_contract: Capture every unignored raw Chromium CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree node for controls-open and modal-open states, including status/live regions. Every expected slider must reconcile to the exact DOM aria-valuetext engineering string with units/state, a dedicated non-live aria-details target containing that exact string, and the raw AX details relation to that target (or an exact direct AX text exposure). Native numeric AX range value remains separately required; numeric fallback alone cannot satisfy engineering-value exposure.
common_capture.automation: Run npm ci, npm run capture:742:install, then npm run capture:742 from the committed candidate. The exact Playwright version is pinned in package-lock.json and the default executable is its bundled Chromium revision. Record and validate the lockfile hash/size, Playwright version, bundled revision, executable identity, and a canonical manifest/root digest covering every regular file and symlink in the Chromium application/resource bundle. Also bind the committed runner hash/size, one structured JSON trace per gate, UTC capture time, and exact screenshots in BROWSER_CAPTURE_ALLOWLIST.json. Explicit absolute tool/browser overrides remain rehearsal-only and cannot satisfy a completed review gate. Each trace outcomes object must byte-canonically hash and exactly equal the gate artifact observations.assertions object; free-form transcripts are non-authoritative and prohibited.
common_capture.repo_owned_replay_command: npm ci && npm run capture:742:install && npm run capture:742 -- --port=8092
common_capture.upstream_identity_rule: Bind upstream route, configuration, release, asset SHA-256, and runtime SHA-256. Do not embed a mutable receipt-file SHA/byte count in the browser artifact: ES predeploy review is later written into that receipt, so such a field would be stale or cyclic. Pages separately hash-binds the final receipt through its build manifest and deployment attestation.
boundaries: local browser or responsive emulation only
no VoiceOver or NVDA session claim

extended_visual_fidelity.binding_rule: Each named semantic observation must embed the exact path, SHA-256, and byte count of its distinct OWNED_RENDER_ALLOWLIST artifact. Counts, unreferenced allowlist entries, separate boolean maps, and path-only lists cannot satisfy this gate.
extended_visual_fidelity.boundary_rule: The observation must state that it contains no manufacturer geometry and is not factory steering or crab calibration.

Fork heels, blades, and the red validated posed-GLB fork-top/load-surface datum with exact contact markers are fully framed at maximum lift.
The selected 3 degree maximum-reach pose and 24 inch load-center reference are visible.
Retract-chain tangent legs, sheave wrap, and moving termination are visible.
One through-rod steering cylinder with two visible rod ends, two rigid tie bars, and four highlighted pivots is visible.
The unobstructed REAR AXLE / FIXED THROUGH-ROD RACK caption identifies the rear state; the through-rod rack, two rigid tie bars, and all four highlighted joints are visible without label overlap.

The visible CIRCLE label reports reconstructed headings FL 55.000 / FR 54.914 / RL -55.000 / RR -54.914 deg, TWO ACTUAL ICR CONSTRUCTIONS, and SCRUB DIAGNOSTIC 93.466% — NOT FACTORY ACKERMANN; both ICR constructions are drawn.
The visible CRAB label reports reconstructed headings FL 55.000 / FR 54.914 / RL 54.914 / RR 55.000 deg, FULL-POSE TOE 0.086 deg, and DENSE MAX 0.753 deg.

The visible FRONT label reports reconstructed headings FL 55.000 / FR 54.914 deg, REAR HELD ALIGNED, ACTUAL FRONT ICR CONSTRUCTIONS, and SCRUB DIAGNOSTIC 61.060% — NOT FACTORY ACKERMANN; the front ICR construction lines are drawn.
Rigid boom-angle sensor crank, link, frame joint, and boom joint are visible.

desktop_browser_interaction.maximum_pose_reset_rule: Press Reset View while the five controls remain at the recorded maximum pose; prove the pose-frame, desired, actual settled, base-max, and effective-max distances are coherent and that Reset View did not stow the mechanism.
desktop_browser_interaction.steering_mode_rule: With nonzero circle steering, request crab and prove the active mode remains circle with a visible center-required status. Center steering, then prove circle, crab, and limited front-only modes each activate before restoring the maximum-pose steering command.
desktop_browser_interaction.terminal_failure_rule: On loopback only, exercise the static bootstrap watchdog, accelerated production asset-timeout path, loader-start throw, unexpected runtime error, and unhandled rejection. Every case must record a non-null strictly changing boot/runtime RAF baseline, then exact terminal source, focused assertive alert, inert app/interface, disabled controls, and unchanged terminal/frame counters after 250 ms. Runtime-error and rejection cases must first prove changing showcase controls plus RAF count.

mobile_browser_interaction.pinch_rule: All four start/end touch coordinates must independently hit the canvas. Wait for actual camera/desired-distance settle before baseline and after the gesture; require a monotonic zoom-in and an actual camera-distance decrease of at least 0.5 m or 2 percent of baseline, whichever is greater. Canvas hash alone cannot pass.
mobile_browser_interaction.screenshot_framing_rule: Retain expanded-control DOM and raw pinch evidence, then stow while the control is reachable, collapse controls through the real responsive toggle, Reset View for the collapsed layout, apply a recorded runtime zoom-out, settle, and project all eight corners of the exact visible stowed GLB bounds through the capture camera. Both presentation screenshots must keep the full projected machine bounds inside the canvas with explicit edge margins and must not intersect the visible controls, component navigation, or diagnostics rectangles.

semantic_selection.visible_canvas_rule: From one deterministic reset/framing sequence, click six independently labeled committed viewport coordinates directly on unobstructed canvas pixels without using component-focus controls to discover or prepare the click. Cover chassis, steering, boom, hydraulics, cab, and carriage exactly once. Require selected component and the runtime's actual frontmost rendered surface component to both equal the independently declared expected component, with resolution basis visible-surface and a nonempty rendered mesh name. Restore/reset framing before the screenshot and prove its projected whole-machine bounds remain inside the canvas and outside the visible control, navigation, and diagnostics rectangles.
semantic_selection.raw_ray_rule: Copy and parse data-selection-overlap-outcomes for all 15 rays. The validator independently recomputes the expected component from hit components/distances, visible-surface component, the fixed 0.025 m tie rule, and its own priority map.
semantic_selection.raw_fixture_rule: Copy every full 9-field data-selection-fixture-outcomes record without stripping hits or semantic fields. The validator independently recomputes basis, component, and volume from raw hit distances/priorities plus visibleSurfaceComponent, checks the committed 5-field projection, and requires exact equality with the DOM-parsed records.

performance_profile.summary_rule: Nearest-rank p95 and worst value rounded to 0.001 ms must be recomputed from the committed raw interval arrays. Before each screenshot, expose a visible captured-window label whose profile, sample count, p95, worst, and >=250 ms stall count exactly equal that same structured summary; a separate rolling diagnostic cannot stand in for the bound window.

600s_browser_regression.reduced_motion_rule: Capture a live no-preference to reduce to no-preference media transition while autonomy is moving. Require motion to stop immediately, manual controls to remain enabled, and autonomy not to resume when the preference returns.
600s_browser_regression.fatal_failure_rule: Inject module, WebGL, asset-network, and asset-contract failures independently. Each must record a non-null changing boot/runtime RAF baseline, then reach its exact terminal source with a focused assertive alert, inert app/interface, all controls disabled, and unchanged terminal/frame counters after 250 ms.
600s_browser_regression.screenshot_framing_rule: Retain raw interaction traces, then stow while the control is reachable, collapse mobile controls through the real responsive toggle, Reset View for the collapsed layout, apply the recorded presentation zoom-out and recorded production keyboard orbit adjustment, settle, and prove all eight corners of the exact visible stowed GLB bounds remain inside the canvas with explicit edge margins and outside visible control, navigation, and diagnostics rectangles.

es1930m_browser_regression.maximum_pose_rule: Capture full lift, full deck extension, and both steering extrema with explicit DOM aria-valuetext for every ES slider and a dedicated maximum-pose screenshot.
es1930m_browser_regression.reduced_motion_rule: Capture a live no-preference to reduce to no-preference media transition while autonomy is moving. Require motion to stop immediately, manual controls to remain enabled, and autonomy not to resume when the preference returns.
es1930m_browser_regression.fatal_failure_rule: Inject module, WebGL, asset-network, and asset-contract failures independently. Each must record a non-null changing boot/runtime RAF baseline, then reach its exact terminal source with a focused assertive alert, inert app/interface, all controls disabled, and unchanged terminal/frame counters after 250 ms.
es1930m_browser_regression.screenshot_framing_rule: Keep the dedicated ES maximum-pose screenshot, but retain raw interaction traces, stow while the control is reachable, collapse mobile controls through the real responsive toggle, Reset View for the collapsed layout, apply the recorded presentation zoom-out, settle, and prove all eight corners of the exact visible stowed GLB bounds remain inside the canvas with explicit edge margins and outside visible control, navigation, and diagnostics rectangles.
